newsitem.title: LEBANON: Most leading shares steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Most leading shares steady in Beirut.

text.p: Most shares began the week unchanged on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday with only Bank of Beirut rising, to $4 from $3.9375.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.53 percent to 159.56. The LISPI stock index rose 0.25 percent to 88.46 and the BLOM general index rose 0.02 percent to 923.66.
Total market turnover was 190,974 shares for a value of $1,731,180 against 219,781 shares traded on Friday at $2,035,042.
Banque Audi was unchanged at $24.875 while the bank's Global Depositary Receipts rose to $27.25 from $27 on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce was also unchanged at $18.5. However, a bloc of 10,000 BLC shares traded on the floor at $18.625.
A block of 40,000 BOB shares also changed hands at $3.9375.
Solidere A and B were steady at $10.25 and $10.75 respectively. The shares continued to trade in heavy demand. The company's GDRs are trading at $15.5-$16 in London.
There was no trade in any of the four listed industrial shares: Ciments Libanais, Ciment Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
